sentences.en: He is handsome. In addition, he is good at sport.
sentences.zh: 他很英俊。此外，他还擅长运动。

sentences.en: The boy who she brought with her was very handsome.
sentences.zh: 她带来的那个男孩非常英俊。

sentences.en: My father is proud of me being tall and handsome.
sentences.zh: 我父亲为我长得高大英俊而感到自豪。

senses.zh: （男子）英俊的，相貌端正的；（物品）美观的，漂亮的；（数量）可观的，数额大的
